errata.why: Owner ruling on #8486 (2026-10-27) replaced the official judge as the run's judge with our own pinned model, and re-stated it 2026-11-03 (owner verbatim: 'i have already mentioned multiple times that we use deepseek and that i want to complete the p0 and p1 issues before doing an eval'; the same comment's own point 2 records 'The model is DeepSeek. Not OpenAI, not OpenRouter' — that sentence is the recording comment's wording, not a quotation of the owner). The pin recorded above is HISTORICAL: it is what gate 4 verified on 2026-09-04, and it is NOT what a step-5 run records. A run under the ruling records judge_pin 'unpinned:deepseek-v4-flash' and verdict 'inconclusive' BY DESIGN (derived from the judge that graded), and must be reported as an internal baseline series - never as the LongMemEval number, and never beside a vendor figure. The official pin is still mintable: only a run the OFFICIAL judge (openai:gpt-4o-2024-08-06) graded carries it.
